name: Sky-Rent Portent
text:
When Sky-Rent Portent enters the battlefield, exile the top ten cards of your library face up. Put an omen counter on each of them.
At the beginning of your upkeep, choose a nonland card you own in exile with an omen counter on it at random. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. When you cast a spell this way, take an extra turn after this one.
Spells you cast from exile have cascade, cascade.
